title: Commit with UNKNOWN PR association is held for classification and never treated as NO_PR

held_items.hold_reason: PR association state is UNKNOWN; must hold classification and must NOT infer NO_PR or emit a DIRECT_COMMIT Event.

expected_proposal.post_mvp_transition_note: Late source association recovery for held UNKNOWN commits is tracked separately under B-003 (POST_MVP, see EV-018).

review_required_items.question: Confirm exact status token and visibility rule (hidden from Event search vs visible in a dedicated uncategorized/pending review bucket) when pr_association_status is UNKNOWN.

rationale.summary: When Snapshot Import cannot determine whether a commit belongs to a PR (pr_association_status='UNKNOWN'), Event classification must be held. Treating UNKNOWN as NO_PR/DIRECT_COMMIT violates ADR-018 and corrupts attribution.
assumptions_without_notion: Exact status name CLASSIFICATION_HELD and whether held commits appear in a separate UI inbox are not confirmed from Notion.
reviewer_questions: Should held UNKNOWN commits have a dedicated Event lifecycle state (e.g., UNCLASSIFIED/HELD) or stay outside the active Event list in a separate held collection?
Confirm whether held items are excluded from default Event search (expected_result_count=0).
